source_row.extraction_instructions: Custom CMS, not WordPress. Listing at /events-courses-exams/?pageSize=12&pageIndex=N (N starts at 1; pageIndex=0 and any page past the last redirect 302). 2 pages currently, 16 raw card links, one item repeated across the page boundary -> 16 unique upcoming shells (list_shells_override dedupes by URL). Cards and the detail-page header share one markup shape: a date span ('28th Sep 2026'), a time span ('- 12:00pm,'), and a venue span ('Online' or a full UK address, sometimes with a UK postcode to strip before picking the city). No probed page (listing or 8 detail pages) ever publishes a fee amount -- booking always routes through either header '.article-options .btn-tertiary' member/non-member buttons (a members.fph.org.uk login-gated portal) or an off-site organiser link named in the article prose (RCPsych's own calendar, an Eventscase page, a Teams meeting link) -- pricing_tiers is correctly always []. CPD points/accreditation are never mentioned on any probed page outside site-wide nav chrome ('Regional CPD Resources' link), so cpd_points/cpd_accredited stay null/False rather than being scraped from nav junk. One event (Specialty Registrars, invite-only) has no public booking link at all -- booking_url falls back to the FPH page itself.

registry_comment: FPH: custom CMS, page-query pagination (?pageSize=12&pageIndex=N), no fees ever published on-site (booking via members-portal login or off-site organiser link)

concerns: This source never publishes a fee amount on its own pages -- registration always goes through a members.fph.org.uk login gate or an off-site organiser site. pricing_tiers will be [] for essentially every FPH row; this is a source characteristic, not an extraction gap.

cpd_points/cpd_accredited are likewise never published anywhere I could find on this source (checked 8 detail pages of different shapes: webinar, in-person conference x2, invite-only session). Left null/False rather than guessed.

Booking-URL heuristic for the off-site-link case (no member-portal buttons) keys off nearby text containing register/book/sign up/rsvp/'please visit'/'conference website'. Verified correct on 3 different off-site link shapes (RCPsych calendar, Eventscase, Teams meeting) plus the one page with neither buttons nor a matching link (correctly returns None). Could still miss an register-link phrasing we haven't seen if a future event uses different wording -- falls back safely to the FPH page URL, never silently wrong data.

'Building Connectivity...Specialty Registrars Event' is invite-only (no public booking route) but not an application/CV-submission scheme, so I kept it per the PLAYBOOK's skip-rule scope (that rule targets job-track programmes, not single dated invite-only sessions) -- flagging in case the team prefers to exclude invite-only events from this source.

Listing pagination: pageIndex=1..2 currently return cards, pageIndex=3 302-redirects with 0 cards (confirmed) -- override loop caps at 6 pages as a safety margin, will naturally stop early via the 0-new-cards check if the site adds/removes pages.

Did not find event_type differentiation (conference/course/workshop) published anywhere as a badge/category on this source -- left event_type unset so the shared title-heuristic + 'conference' default in llm_agent._merge_shell_and_detail handles it (worked correctly on the sample: 'Webinar' titles vs 'Conference 2026' titles).
